description: Procurement for the supply of 920,000 prefilled syringes/vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 4000IU in 0.4ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding method for the procurement of 920,000 prefilled syringes/vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection, 4000IU in 0.4ml, used in the treatment of heart patients, and seven (07) bids were received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to Shenzhen Techdow Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd. of China (Manufacturer: Shenzhen Techdow Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., China), substantially responsive lowest bidder for a sum of USD 828,000, inclusive of cost and freight charges, was approved by the Cabinet.
